compute_ik_joint_angles: compute inverse kinematics to get joint angles for a desired end-effector position and orientation
set_ee_pose: command the robot arm to move to a desired end-effector pose using IK and path planning
get_joint_angles: get the current joint angles of all arm joints as a numpy array
compute_fk_position: compute forward kinematics to get the end-effector position and rotation matrix from joint angles
move_ee_xyz: move the end effector by a displacement in xyz directions with linear interpolation and IK solving
